(25 November)}} |lowest attendance= |attendance=1,716,462 |average attendance=7,152 |prevseason=[[2017 Chilean Primera División|2017]] |nextseason=[[2019 Chilean Primera División|2019]] }} The '''2018 [[Chilean Primera División|Campeonato Nacional]]''', known as '''Campeonato Nacional Scotiabank 2018''' for sponsorship purposes, was the 88th season of top-flight football in [[Chile]]. The season started on 2 February and ended on 2 December. [[Colo-Colo]] were the defending champions, having won the [[2017 Chilean Primera División|2017 Transición]] tournament. [[Club Deportivo Universidad Católica|Universidad Católica]] won their thirteenth title on the last day of the season following a 2–1 win at [[Deportes Temuco]], who were relegated to the second tier with this defeat.{{cite web|url=https://www.latercera.com/el-deportivo/noticia/la-uc-abraza-la-estrella-13-sur/427434/|title=La UC abraza la estrella 13 en el sur|publisher=latercera.com|language=es|date=2 December 2018}} ==Format changes== For the 2018 season, the [[Asociación Nacional de Fútbol Profesional]] (ANFP) approved a change of format from the Apertura-Clausura system that had been used in previous seasons, to a single tournament during the calendar year.{{cite web|url=https://www.latercera.com/noticia/2018-vuelve-torneo-largo/|title=El 2018 vuelve el torneo largo|publisher=latercera.com|language=es}} The 16 teams played each other twice (once at home and once away) for a total of 30 matches. Qualification for the [[2019 Copa Libertadores|Copa Libertadores]] and [[2019 Copa Sudamericana|Copa Sudamericana]] was awarded to the top seven teams at the end of the season, as well as the [[2018 Copa Chile|Copa Chile]] champions, while the bottom two teams were automatically relegated.{{cite web|url=https://www.t13.cl/noticia/deportes13/futbol-nacional/digan-verdad-web/a-europea-anfp-ratifica-torneo-largo-2018-varias-novedades|title=A la “europea”: ANFP ratifica torneo largo para el 2018 con varias novedades|publisher=t13.cl|language=es}} ==Teams== ===Stadia and locations=== {{location map+ |Chile |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2018 Chilean Primera División teams. |places= {{location map~ |Chile |lat=-34.983333|long=-71.233333|label=
